clue.text: Succeed getting increase for research

parts.note: to succeed someone is to come after them, to follow
an increase is a rise, something going up

explanation.surface: Someone wins a promotion and a pay rise in return for their research work.
explanation.definitionFit: To follow up a lead is to investigate it further, which is a kind of research.

clue.text: Opening old foodstuff that's provided inside

indicators.note: inside says the word for provided goes within the foodstuff

parts.note: rice is a staple foodstuff
provided, as in 'provided that', means if

explanation.surface: A hatch for passing in stale food that someone has supplied.
explanation.definitionFit: An orifice is a mouth or hole, an opening into something.

clue.text: Almost give up when sporting hero's late

indicators.note: sporting is read as frolicking, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fan nearly despairs as the sports star fails to turn up on time.
explanation.definitionFit: To lose heart is to become discouraged, close to abandoning an effort.

clue.text: Not entirely fit, getting benefit

indicators.note: not entirely means the synonym for fit loses its final letter

parts.note: fit, as in suitable or deserving, means worthy

explanation.surface: Someone not fully fit still gains something from exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: Worth as a noun is value or usefulness, the benefit something offers.

clue.text: Idealised view?

parts.note: a view in the literal sense, the pretty scene printed on a holiday card, which also describes anything charmingly perfect

explanation.definitionFit: A scene that looks too perfect to be real is called this, after the scenic photos on holiday mail.

clue.text: Business graduate entertained by lad in city once

indicators.note: entertained by means held inside, so the graduate goes within the lad

parts.note: a lad is a boy
an MBA is a Master of Business Administration

explanation.surface: An MBA holder is hosted by a young man in some city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'city once' because the Indian city is now officially Mumbai.
explanation.definitionFit: This was the former name of Mumbai, India's financial capital.

clue.text: Please German navy flyer

parts.note: bitte is the German word for please
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A request made politely to a German naval airman.
explanation.definitionFit: The bittern is a wading bird of the heron family, and birds fly.

clue.text: Island sporting authority upset American at first

indicators.note: at first places the turned piece at the front of the answer
upset in a down clue turns the word for American upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: the LTA is the Lawn Tennis Association, the body governing British tennis

explanation.surface: An island's tennis governing body is annoyed with an American from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Malta is a Mediterranean island nation south of Sicily.

clue.text: Poisonous substance implicated in scare

indicators.note: implicated is read as entangled or folded in, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A toxin is linked to a public health alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: Arsenic is a notoriously toxic element, the classic poisoner's choice.

clue.text: Slip of a girl

definitions.meaning: to fail to hit or catch, a slip

explanation.definitionFit: A miss is both a failure to connect and a form of address for a young woman.

clue.text: Performer's revised article is on time

definitions.note: performer's stands for performer is, the link to the wordplay

indicators.note: revised means reworked, so the letters of these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A performer's article was rewritten and came in on deadline.
explanation.definitionFit: A recitalist is a musician or speaker who gives solo recitals.

clue.text: Flash residence?

parts.note: a flash is a burst of light
a residence is a house

explanation.surface: A showy, posh home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flash' reads as the British slang for showy or posh, but it is the beam that sweeps out from the tower.
explanation.definitionFit: The coastal tower that houses a flashing beacon is literally a building for a light.

clue.text: Don't start to ridicule family member

indicators.note: don't start means drop the opening letter of the synonym for ridicule

parts.note: to ridicule someone is to taunt them

explanation.surface: Advice not to begin mocking a relative.
explanation.definitionFit: Your parent's sister is a relative, a member of the family.

clue.text: It grows inside a fenced arboretum

indicators.note: inside says the answer lies within the letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A tree flourishes within the walls of a tree collection.
explanation.definitionFit: A cedar is a tree, and trees grow.

clue.text: Concerned with current support

parts.note: re means about or concerning, as in a letter heading
a rule that is current is in force

explanation.surface: Worried about electric current, someone props up the wiring.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinforce something is to strengthen or back it up.

clue.text: Exaggerated having a degree of debt

definitions.meaning: a portrait or account drawn too strongly is exaggerated
a bank account taken below zero leaves the holder owing money

explanation.definitionFit: Overdrawn describes both a character overstated and a bank account gone into the red.

clue.text: Church run into trouble with old campaigner?

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: trouble is read as stir up, so these letters are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: The church gets into difficulties with an elderly activist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old campaigner' suggests a veteran politician; it is a Roman army officer, who went on military campaigns in ancient times.
explanation.definitionFit: A centurion commanded about a hundred soldiers in the ancient Roman army, a soldier of old wars.

clue.text: Slates embedded in English river area

indicators.note: embedded in means set inside, so the word for slates goes within the river

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, in south-west England
to slate is to criticise harshly, and so is to pan

explanation.surface: Roofing slates are found stuck in the bed of an English river.
explanation.definitionFit: An expanse is a wide open stretch, an area of land or sea.

clue.text: Keep soldiers further in the rear

definitions.meaning: to keep something back for later is to hold it in store
troops held back behind the front line, ready to be called up

explanation.definitionFit: Reserve means both to set aside and the body of troops kept behind the front line.

clue.text: Given a hand to negotiate with leader of tribe

parts.note: to deal is to bargain or do business, to negotiate

indicators.note: leader of means take the opening letter of the word tribe

explanation.surface: Someone receives help to bargain with a tribal chief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Given a hand' suggests being helped; at cards a player is dealt a hand.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games each player is dealt cards, given a hand.

clue.text: Police action?

parts.note: the police are the law, and an action in court is a suit, so a court case reads as the police's case

explanation.definitionFit: A lawsuit is a legal action brought in court.

clue.text: Tiff blows over

indicators.note: over says the word for blows is turned back to front

parts.note: light blows are taps

explanation.surface: A quarrel blows over quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: A spat is a petty quarrel, a tiff.

clue.text: Body of soldiers left without opposition, initially moving north

indicators.note: in a down clue moving north means the letters are read upwards, reversed
without means outside, so the word for left goes around the letter

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

indicators.note: initially means take the opening letter of the word opposition

explanation.surface: A unit of soldiers, left unopposed, begins advancing north.
explanation.definitionFit: A troop is a unit of soldiers, especially of cavalry.

clue.text: Have agreed before to live a quieter life

indicators.note: before says the word for agreed comes ahead of the word for have

parts.note: a deal that is agreed is settled
to have something is to own it

explanation.surface: A couple who reached an agreement beforehand opt for a calmer existence.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle down is to adopt a calmer, steadier way of living.

clue.text: University heads to be heard

indicators.note: to be heard says the word for heads is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: to head is to lead, so heads means leads

explanation.surface: Heads of a university are about to be consulted.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeds is a city in northern England with a university of that name.

clue.text: I fancy roue's becoming too blatant

indicators.note: becoming means turning into something else, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive s adds no letter

explanation.surface: Someone admits to fancying a womaniser who is getting far too brazen.
explanation.definitionFit: In-your-face describes behaviour so blatant and confrontational it cannot be ignored.

clue.text: Touch on key objection

parts.note: A is a musical key
a but is an objection, as in 'no ifs or buts'

explanation.surface: Mention a crucial objection.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that abut touch along a shared border.

clue.text: Fowl in deep pastry dish?

parts.note: the deep is a poetic term for the sea
a pie is a pastry dish

explanation.surface: A bird baked in a deep-dish pie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fowl in deep pastry dish' suggests a poultry pie; the sea pie is a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Sea pie is an old name for the oystercatcher, a shore bird.

clue.text: Director is one to cause conflict

parts.note: unity is oneness, the state of being one

explanation.surface: A film director is the one who stirs up trouble on set.
explanation.definitionFit: Disunity is disagreement and division, a state of conflict.
